records.title: Curiosity / Gale Crater weather
records.coverage: Rover-local measurements along its traverse; exact sample coordinates are not supplied in this feed. Crater centre is a reference only, not the sensor location.
records.resolution: Daily summary of sampled rover observations; no geographic grid.
records.uncertainty: Numerical uncertainties are not supplied by the summary. Sampling gaps and rover/instrument effects can affect extrema. Outreach data, not operational or calibrated PDS time series.

records.title: Curiosity Mastcam aerosol optical depth
records.kind: Historical derived observation — PDS review copy
records.coverage: Atmospheric column above Curiosity, not surface dust concentration. Product time span: 2012-09-08T23:17:00.000Z to 2023-09-19T18:56:00.000Z.
records.resolution: One solar-image retrieval at 880 nm, not a regional or daily average.
records.uncertainty: Source Sigma = 0.030. Confidence convention not specified in the table label. Aerosols include dust and ice. The linked PDS copy is under /review/; certification is not asserted. No visibility, toxicity or storm severity is inferred.

records.title: Curiosity RAD ionizing radiation
records.coverage: Curiosity surface observations in Gale Crater; not a Jezero or planet-wide dose map.
records.resolution: Multi-month average reported by NASA, not a live radiation monitor.
records.uncertainty: Numerical uncertainty is not supplied in the NASA news summary. Solar events, shielding and solar-cycle conditions affect exposure; not a personal dosimeter or an EVA dose prediction. UV and MEDA optical radiation are not equivalent to ionizing dose.
